protection.title: VPNTE network protection

state.off: No protection filters needed: the kill switch is off.
state.armed: Ready: the filters come with the next connection.
state.blockingStrict: Strict mode: traffic outside the VPN is blocked, as intended.
state.blocking: Traffic is blocked: the VPN dropped and the filters stayed. Reconnect the VPN or turn the kill switch off.

protection.bfeRunning: The BFE service (Base Filtering Engine) is running.
protection.bfeStopped: The BFE service (Base Filtering Engine) is not running: the kill switch and route protection are unavailable.
protection.leftoverFilters: Persistent VPNTE filters left over: {{n}}. Repair removes them.
protection.strictMissing: Strict mode is on but there are no persistent filters: nothing blocks traffic outside the VPN.

fwBlock.domain: Windows Firewall, Domain profile: outgoing connections are blocked by default (the profile is not in use).
fwBlock.private: Windows Firewall, Private profile: outgoing connections are blocked by default (the profile is not in use).
fwBlock.public: Windows Firewall, Public profile: outgoing connections are blocked by default (the profile is not in use).

fwBlockActive.domain: Windows Firewall, active Domain profile: outgoing connections are blocked by default. Allow the VPN engines in Windows Firewall or set outbound to Allow.
fwBlockActive.private: Windows Firewall, active Private profile: outgoing connections are blocked by default. Allow the VPN engines in Windows Firewall or set outbound to Allow.
fwBlockActive.public: Windows Firewall, active Public profile: outgoing connections are blocked by default. Allow the VPN engines in Windows Firewall or set outbound to Allow.
